name: MYNEWS
recent: MYNEWS 在 2026 年 9 月 24 日公布了截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度业绩，随后有新闻指出成本压力将影响其前景。11 月 13 日，公司公告董事在闭市期内有交易意向。
notable: 董事在闭市期内表示有交易意向。
risks: 新闻标题指出成本压力将影响公司前景。

news.title: Cost pressures to weigh on MyNews prospects

recent_en: MYNEWS announced its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on 24 September 2026, followed by news reports highlighting cost pressures affecting its prospects. On 13 November, the company announced directors' intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Directors indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: News headlines highlighted cost pressures weighing on the company's prospects.
